title: 茶葉萎凋乾燥自動監測
titleEn: Tea Withering and Drying Automated Monitoring
summary: 以「茶葉萎凋的失水與乾物質守恆」展開10單元、40步，包含機制、合成算例、獨立驗證和「將總失重全部當作水分」的診斷。
summaryEn: Ten units and forty steps on Water loss and dry-solids conservation during tea withering, with mechanisms, synthetic calculations, independent checks and diagnosis of Treating all weight loss as water.
scope: 五個案例脈絡模型單元加五個明示共通量測方法單元；41類技術方法會重用，395個案例各有獨立焦點與失效情境。數值全部為合成教學假設，來源支持公開原理和方法，不宣稱已查明每個設施的內部規格、完工狀態或現場操作流程。醫療內容僅限數位/惰性台架，不含診療、病人參數或設備操作。
scopeEn: Five case-context model units plus five explicitly shared measurement-method units. Methods recur across 41 technical families, while 395 cases have individual focuses and failure scenarios. All numbers are synthetic teaching assumptions. Sources support public principles/methods, not every facility’s internal specifications, completion status or operations. Biomedical work uses digital/inert benches only, with no treatment, patient settings or device operation.

stages.routeEn: Complete mechanism, estimate, verification and diagnosis as a learning path, not an operating sequence.

steps.title: 單元1｜移除水量：機制與界面
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Water removal: Mechanism and interfaces
steps.objective: 以「茶葉萎凋的失水與乾物質守恆」完成機制與界面並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete mechanism and interfaces for Water loss and dry-solids conservation during tea withering with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課焦點「茶葉萎凋的失水與乾物質守恆」。畫出「原料含水 → 熱交換 → 水分遷移 → 產品 → 空白及取樣」並圈出與「移除水量」有關的介面。將 initial*(wet-final)/(1-final) 每個變數標到圖上，寫明單位、方向及資料來源。解釋：以乾物質守恆計算由起始濕基含水率降到最終濕基含水率的移水量。 再指出這個局部模型無法回答的項目：假設無乾物質流失、添加或反應；濕基分率需小於1。
steps.instructionEn: The case focus is Water loss and dry-solids conservation during tea withering. Draw Feed moisture → Heat exchange → Water transfer → Product → Blank and samples and mark the interfaces relevant to Water removal. Place every variable of initial*(wet-final)/(1-final) on the drawing with units, direction and provenance. Explain: Dry-solids conservation gives water removal between initial and final wet-basis moisture. Identify what it cannot establish: Assumes no solids loss, additions or reaction; wet-basis fractions must be below one.
steps.observation: 對照「茶葉萎凋的失水與乾物質守恆」，輸入變數與量測結果不同：先定義可觀察量，再決定能否使用這個式子。前五單元把共通物理模型套入本課案例；這是局部子系統估算，不是整座設施模型。
steps.observationEn: For Water loss and dry-solids conservation during tea withering, distinguish inputs from observed outcomes before deciding whether this equation applies. A shared physical model is applied to the case subsystem, not a complete facility model.
steps.failure: 將總失重全部當作水分；假設無乾物質流失、添加或反應；濕基分率需小於1。
steps.failureEn: Treating all weight loss as water; Assumes no solids loss, additions or reaction; wet-basis fractions must be below one.
steps.check: 提交標註介面圖及變數表；每個變數有單位與假設/來源/量測標籤，並明列「假設無乾物質流失、添加或反應；濕基分率需小於1。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit the interface diagram and variable table with units and assumed/sourced/measured labels, explicitly recording: Assumes no solids loss, additions or reaction; wet-basis fractions must be below one.

steps.title: 單元1｜移除水量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Water removal: Quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以「茶葉萎凋的失水與乾物質守恆」完成定量估算並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete quantitative estimate for Water loss and dry-solids conservation during tea withering with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課焦點「茶葉萎凋的失水與乾物質守恆」的「移除水量」採以下合成教學值：initial=10 kg；wet=0.4 kg/kg wet basis；final=0.1 kg/kg wet basis。先逐項檢查量綱，再代入 initial*(wet-final)/(1-final)；獨立基準為 3.33333333 kg。把 initial 增加10%，其他輸入保持原值；先預測方向再重算，結果應為 3.66666667 kg。將數值、單位與是否可外推分欄記錄。
steps.instructionEn: For Water loss and dry-solids conservation during tea withering, use synthetic inputs for Water removal: initial=10 kg；wet=0.4 kg/kg wet basis；final=0.1 kg/kg wet basis. Check dimensions before evaluating initial*(wet-final)/(1-final); the independent benchmark is 3.33333333 kg. Increase initial by 10% with other inputs fixed. Predict direction, then recompute to obtain 3.66666667 kg. Record value, unit and limits separately.
steps.observation: initial增加10%後，結果增加；變化量為 0.333333333 kg。假設無乾物質流失、添加或反應；濕基分率需小於1。
steps.observationEn: After the 10% input change the result should increase, changing by 0.333333333 kg. Assumes no solids loss, additions or reaction; wet-basis fractions must be below one.
steps.failure: 將總失重全部當作水分；假設無乾物質流失、添加或反應；濕基分率需小於1。
steps.failureEn: Treating all weight loss as water; Assumes no solids loss, additions or reaction; wet-basis fractions must be below one.
steps.check: 原值重算與 3.33333333 kg 相符；10%案例與 3.66666667 相符（算術相對容差1e-8）。這個容差只驗算術，不是設備驗收標準。
steps.checkEn: Match 3.33333333 kg at baseline and 3.66666667 after variation within relative arithmetic tolerance 1e-8. This checks arithmetic, not equipment acceptance.

quiz.question: 合成基準的正確結果是哪個（kg）？
quiz.explanation: 按 initial*(wet-final)/(1-final) 逐項代入，結果為 3.33333333；輸入全部為教學假設。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting into initial*(wet-final)/(1-final) gives 3.33333333; all inputs are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 單元1｜移除水量：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Water removal: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「茶葉萎凋的失水與乾物質守恆」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Water loss and dry-solids conservation during tea withering with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「茶葉萎凋的失水與乾物質守恆」設計「移除水量」的獨立驗證：記錄初末質量並獨立測乾物質；兩者推算的移水量需一致。 只用數位物料帳和熱曲線，保存濕乾基準；計算不提供食品安全處理條件。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Water loss and dry-solids conservation during tea withering, independently verify Water removal: Record initial/final masses and independently measure dry solids; compare inferred removed water. Use digital balances and thermal curves with moisture basis; calculations are not food-safety process settings. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「將總失重全部當作水分」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate Treating all weight loss as water rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 將總失重全部當作水分；假設無乾物質流失、添加或反應；濕基分率需小於1。
steps.failureEn: Treating all weight loss as water; Assumes no solids loss, additions or reaction; wet-basis fractions must be below one.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「假設無乾物質流失、添加或反應；濕基分率需小於1。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state Assumes no solids loss, additions or reaction; wet-basis fractions must be below one.

只保留最後的通過字樣。
把無效輸入刪掉後稱全部通過。
optionsEn: Retain raw data and perform: Record initial/final masses and independently measure dry solids; compare inferred removed water.
Delete invalid inputs and claim all cases passed.

steps.instruction: 本課失效情境是「將總失重全部當作水分」。以本單元「移除水量」的變數表建立兩個競爭解釋：真實工程量改變，以及感測/單位/邊界錯誤。選用「記錄初末質量並獨立測乾物質；兩者推算的移水量需一致。」作區分證據；記錄哪個觀測會推翻各解釋。最後交付介面圖、基準與敏感度計算、A/B/C測試，以及仍缺的證據。
steps.instructionEn: The case failure is Treating all weight loss as water. For Water removal, compare a real engineering change with a sensing/unit/boundary error. Use Record initial/final masses and independently measure dry solids; compare inferred removed water. to discriminate and state an observation that would refute each explanation. Deliver the diagram, baseline/sensitivity calculations, A/B/C tests and remaining evidence gaps.

steps.instruction: 本課焦點「茶葉萎凋的失水與乾物質守恆」的「顯熱需求」採以下合成教學值：mass=2 kg；cp=500 J/(kg K)；delta=10 K。先逐項檢查量綱，再代入 mass*cp*delta/1000；獨立基準為 10 kJ。把 mass 增加10%，其他輸入保持原值；先預測方向再重算，結果應為 11 kJ。將數值、單位與是否可外推分欄記錄。
steps.instructionEn: For Water loss and dry-solids conservation during tea withering, use synthetic inputs for Sensible heat: mass=2 kg；cp=500 J/(kg K)；delta=10 K. Check dimensions before evaluating mass*cp*delta/1000; the independent benchmark is 10 kJ. Increase mass by 10% with other inputs fixed. Predict direction, then recompute to obtain 11 kJ. Record value, unit and limits separately.
steps.observation: mass增加10%後，結果增加；變化量為 1 kJ。假設比熱固定且無相變；有蒸發、熔化或反應熱時須另列項。
steps.observationEn: After the 10% input change the result should increase, changing by 1 kJ. Assumes constant heat capacity and no phase change; evaporation, melting and reaction require separate terms.
steps.failure: 將總失重全部當作水分；假設比熱固定且無相變；有蒸發、熔化或反應熱時須另列項。
steps.failureEn: Treating all weight loss as water; Assumes constant heat capacity and no phase change; evaporation, melting and reaction require separate terms.
steps.check: 原值重算與 10 kJ 相符；10%案例與 11 相符（算術相對容差1e-8）。這個容差只驗算術，不是設備驗收標準。
steps.checkEn: Match 10 kJ at baseline and 11 after variation within relative arithmetic tolerance 1e-8. This checks arithmetic, not equipment acceptance.

quiz.question: 合成基準的正確結果是哪個（kJ）？
quiz.explanation: 按 mass*cp*delta/1000 逐項代入，結果為 10；輸入全部為教學假設。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting into mass*cp*delta/1000 gives 10; all inputs are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 原理與模型
knowledge.text: 顯熱由質量、比熱與溫差相乘；功率與能量需另用時間換算。
knowledge.textEn: Sensible heat is mass times heat capacity times temperature difference; use time to distinguish power and energy.

knowledge.title: 案例與驗證界限
knowledge.text: 茶葉萎凋的失水與乾物質守恆。假設比熱固定且無相變；有蒸發、熔化或反應熱時須另列項。 前五單元把共通物理模型套入本課案例；這是局部子系統估算，不是整座設施模型。
knowledge.textEn: Water loss and dry-solids conservation during tea withering. Assumes constant heat capacity and no phase change; evaporation, melting and reaction require separate terms. A shared physical model is applied to the case subsystem, not a complete facility model.

steps.title: 單元2｜顯熱需求：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Sensible heat: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「茶葉萎凋的失水與乾物質守恆」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Water loss and dry-solids conservation during tea withering with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「茶葉萎凋的失水與乾物質守恆」設計「顯熱需求」的獨立驗證：記錄質量、起終溫度、溫度探頭位置及空白容器熱容量。 只用數位物料帳和熱曲線，保存濕乾基準；計算不提供食品安全處理條件。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Water loss and dry-solids conservation during tea withering, independently verify Sensible heat: Record mass, initial/final temperature, probe positions and empty-container heat capacity. Use digital balances and thermal curves with moisture basis; calculations are not food-safety process settings. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「將總失重全部當作水分」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate Treating all weight loss as water rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 將總失重全部當作水分；假設比熱固定且無相變；有蒸發、熔化或反應熱時須另列項。
steps.failureEn: Treating all weight loss as water; Assumes constant heat capacity and no phase change; evaporation, melting and reaction require separate terms.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「假設比熱固定且無相變；有蒸發、熔化或反應熱時須另列項。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state Assumes constant heat capacity and no phase change; evaporation, melting and reaction require separate terms.

quiz.question: 哪一份驗證紀錄可供他人重做？
options: 只保留最後的通過字樣。
把無效輸入刪掉後稱全部通過。
保留原始資料並執行：記錄質量、起終溫度、溫度探頭位置及空白容器熱容量。
optionsEn: Delete invalid inputs and claim all cases passed.
Retain raw data and perform: Record mass, initial/final temperature, probe positions and empty-container heat capacity.
quiz.explanation: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「假設比熱固定且無相變；有蒸發、熔化或反應熱時須另列項。」。
quiz.explanationEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state Assumes constant heat capacity and no phase change; evaporation, melting and reaction require separate terms.

steps.title: 單元2｜顯熱需求：失效診斷與交付
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Sensible heat: Diagnosis and deliverable
steps.objective: 以「茶葉萎凋的失水與乾物質守恆」完成失效診斷與交付並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete diagnosis and deliverable for Water loss and dry-solids conservation during tea withering with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課失效情境是「將總失重全部當作水分」。以本單元「顯熱需求」的變數表建立兩個競爭解釋：真實工程量改變，以及感測/單位/邊界錯誤。選用「記錄質量、起終溫度、溫度探頭位置及空白容器熱容量。」作區分證據；記錄哪個觀測會推翻各解釋。最後交付介面圖、基準與敏感度計算、A/B/C測試，以及仍缺的證據。
steps.instructionEn: The case failure is Treating all weight loss as water. For Sensible heat, compare a real engineering change with a sensing/unit/boundary error. Use Record mass, initial/final temperature, probe positions and empty-container heat capacity. to discriminate and state an observation that would refute each explanation. Deliver the diagram, baseline/sensitivity calculations, A/B/C tests and remaining evidence gaps.
steps.observation: 「將總失重全部當作水分」不是單靠 10 kJ 就能排除；需要對應量測與適用邊界。
steps.observationEn: The number 10 kJ alone cannot exclude Treating all weight loss as water; matched measurements and applicability boundaries are needed.
steps.failure: 將總失重全部當作水分；假設比熱固定且無相變；有蒸發、熔化或反應熱時須另列項。
steps.failureEn: Treating all weight loss as water; Assumes constant heat capacity and no phase change; evaporation, melting and reaction require separate terms.
steps.check: 交付單元2的五項證據包；清楚寫出「茶葉萎凋的失水與乾物質守恆」中此模型可解釋與不可解釋的部分，並保留失敗案例。
steps.checkEn: Deliver the five-item evidence pack for unit 2, stating what the model can/cannot explain for Water loss and dry-solids conservation during tea withering and retaining failed cases.
